gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-literata: Friendly and inviting, Playpen Sans Arabic draws its tube-like, constant-width strokes like a hand with a drafting pen, while Literata sits below it. Literata's curves thicken gently at the shoulders.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-deva-fs-bespoke-sans: Graceful and inviting, Playpen Sans Deva looks traced with a single marker, its terminals cut open so the shapes flow outward. Bespoke Sans stays sharp beside it.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-hebrew-fs-bespoke-sa: Personal, graceful and handmade, Playpen Sans Hebrew leads. Shrink it too far and its marker-like line loses charm next to Bespoke Sans, which is sharp and refined.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-hebrew-fs-literata: Casual pen-drawn charm, no swelling or tapering anywhere. Literata, a classic serif, handles the finer work, its sturdy thin lines joining thicker ones gently, while Playpen Sans Hebrew stays loose and personal.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-fs-bespoke-sans: Friendly and casual, Playpen Sans Thai writes every stroke at the same visual weight. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans, would read smoothly over a longer passage, its curve ends held generously away from the stems.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-fs-literata: Literata is a classic serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, set against Playpen Sans Thai, whose strokes show no contrast whatsoever. A longer stretch of it feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-graduate: Loud, wobbly, full of character. Shantell Sans does expressive display work with its wide mouths and one fixed nib width, while Graduate, a classic serif, brings dignified, generously spaced letters for reading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-graduate: Round, commanding and a bit cheeky. Graduate, a classic serif, then gives Sniglet's level, accent-free display letters a dignified, widely spaced partner with a taller lowercase underneath.
gen-gf-the-girl-next-door-fs-asap: Big, loopy, hand-lettered warmth. Asap, a sans with open arcs and a body height close to its capitals, gives The Girl Next Door's unshaded strokes a straightforward counterpart.
gen-gf-the-girl-next-door-fs-epilogue: An oversized x-height and a broad hooked c make The Girl Next Door unmistakable, with graceful, personal strokes. Epilogue, a sans-serif with a wire-like monoline skeleton, reads smoothly and approachably over a longer passage.
